newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian bond exchange auction totals 14.50 bln bfr.
newsitem.headline: Belgian bond exchange auction totals 14.50 bln bfr.

text.p: The Belgian Treasury's bond exchange auction on Tuesday totalled 14.5 billion francs, the Treasury said in a statement.

At the auction, participants could exchange the November 1996 linear bond (code 270) and January 1997 OLO (code 279) against the following bonds: April 1999 (code 264), March 2001 (code 285), May 2006 (code 283) and July 2008 (code 268).
